editorial.blurb: A vibrant spot where Chinese and Mexican cuisines collide in the most delicious way—think crispy al pastor tacos and their showstopping al pastor fried rice.
editorial.insiderTip: Hit up Asian Cuisine Express on a Monday for their $1.50 al pastor tacos before 5:30pm to avoid the lines, and definitely ask for the homemade chili oil to elevate your meal.
